spec.title: CRACKOUT
spec.oneLiner: Break three formations, crack tough bricks, and catch pickups before the ball escapes.
mechanics: The player moves the paddle horizontally with LEFT/RIGHT; A launches a ball from the paddle during serve and, during an active rally, opens the foundation's 0.3-second power-return window with a 0.9-second cooldown. B holds precision movement for slower, finer paddle control.

The ball rebounds from side walls, the ceiling, the paddle, and bricks using swept collision; paddle contact position and paddle motion control the return angle, while a nonzero horizontal floor prevents permanently vertical loops. Ball speed is capped at 218 pixels per second.

Bricks have durability 1, 2, or 3. A hit on a durable brick advances its crack state and shows a brief impact flash; only the final hit destroys it and awards points once. Each formation contains at least one cracked two-hit brick and one heavily fractured three-hit brick.

Every sixth destroyed brick drops the cycling pickup sequence: wide paddle for 10 seconds, slow ball movement for 8 seconds, then up to three simultaneous balls. Catching a pickup awards 50 points; missed pickups disappear at the bottom without penalty.

Destroying bricks awards 20 points times their original durability plus up to 80 bonus points from the consecutive-destruction combo. A paddle return resets the combo, while uninterrupted destruction raises it; display a short score pop and combo feedback.

The run starts in a harmless serve state with the paddle responsive immediately. Losing the final active ball costs one life, resets the combo, and returns to serve; the player has 3 lives and a 360-second overall limit.

Clearing a formation awards 250 points, briefly enters a clear pause, then presents the next formation for an explicit A launch. Clearing the third formation calls win; exhausting lives or reaching the time limit calls game over.

Difficulty escalates by formation rather than endless speed: stage one teaches single-hit routes, stage two adds more two-hit bricks and narrower recovery lanes, and stage three concentrates three-hit bricks and denser formations. Ball speed and simultaneous-ball count remain capped.
spec.artDirection: 256x224 fixed-screen arcade court below the HUD. Use the foundation's readable 8-column brick formations, with ordinary bricks in bright cyan and yellow, two-hit bricks visibly split by a dark crack, and three-hit bricks showing a larger fractured center before destruction. The paddle is a bold 32-pixel horizontal bar near the bottom, with a distinct widened pickup form; the ball is a high-contrast 4x4 or 5x5 pixel diamond. Falling pickups are clearly distinct 8x8 icons: wide paddle, slow ball, and multiball, using strong silhouettes rather than color alone. Keep the background nearly black with a restrained star-speckle or geometric border, leaving the brick field and ball unobscured. Show impact flashes and small colored debris only on brick damage or destruction. Formation silhouettes should visibly differ across the three stages: compact pyramid, stepped fortress, and zigzag crown.

preserve: Single paddle deflects a ball upward into a field of destructible bricks.
Three distinct brick formations form sequential stages.
Brick durability visibly changes as bricks crack and require multiple hits.
Falling pickups create useful temporary advantages during rallies.
Classic serve, active rally, lost-ball, lives, score, and stage-clear structure.
change: Add three authored formations as the complete progression.
Use tough multi-hit bricks that crack before breaking.
Include the foundation's cycling pickups as a core reward.

controls.left: Move paddle left during serve, active rally, and pickup collection.
controls.right: Move paddle right during serve, active rally, and pickup collection.
controls.a: Launch during serve or stage-clear serve pause; during an active rally, trigger the 0.3-second power-return window if its 0.9-second cooldown is ready.
controls.b: Hold for precision paddle movement during serve and active rally.

spec.lose: Lose a life when the final active ball falls below the paddle, or lose the run when all 3 lives are exhausted or the 360-second limit expires.
spec.scoring: Destroyed bricks score 20 times their original durability plus a consecutive-destruction bonus capped at 80; pickups score 50 and stage clears score 250.
